author: Seung Wook
problem: entries is a lighthouse keeper's log, oldest first. Return the n most recent entries (n >= 0), oldest first, with surrounding spaces removed.
bug_description: Slices entries[-n:], which returns the whole log when n is 0 because -0 is 0.

comments.accurate: The n latest log entries, trimmed, oldest first
comments.wrong_behavior: Last n log entries taken with a negative slice, trimmed
comments.wrong_location: Slice start verified; check each entry is stripped of surrounding spaces
